title: Menu Data Schema
description: A universal JSON Schema for structured restaurant menu data.

category.description: The category name of the dishes, e.g., Appetizers, Main Courses, or Set Meals.

price.description: The total price defined at the category level, typically used for fixed-price set meals.

items.description: The list of dishes under this specific category.

name.description: The full name of the dish.

price.description: The individual price of the dish.

options.description: Optional conditions or choices, such as cold/hot, spicy/non-spicy, meat types, or selectable items in a combo.

description.description: Additional text explanations or ingredient notes provided on the menu.
